skill.summary: Create concise 60-90 second video scripts for tutors to showcase their teaching approach, subject expertise, and student success stories.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Tutoring Video skill.

- Assists tutors and tutoring services in creating short enrollment and credibility videos.
- Guides users through selecting video type and gathering relevant content (subjects, credentials, outcomes).
- Generates 60–90 second video scripts showcasing expertise, tutoring methods, and student success.
- Supports a range of video formats, including introductions, subject showcases, and session previews.
